method.sample_resident_limit: u64::MAX for both baseline and optimized measurements. Separate runs verify the unchanged 2 GiB limit.
method.timing: Instant around FlightProvider::open only. Cursor serialization and hashing run after that timer.
method.rss: Maximum RSS reported by /usr/bin/time for the complete probe process, including cursor serialization and hashing; not provider-only live bytes.
method.resident_accounting: Cumulative positive WorkDelta.resident_bytes authorization, including reallocation capacity. This is not measured live heap or RSS.
method.order: Five baseline runs, then five final optimized runs on the same host and immutable file. No concurrent tests or builds during these samples. OS page-cache state was not reset.
method.digest: SHA-256 of each serde_json EventRecord followed by a newline, then the serialized ProviderSummary. The probe uses the same synthetic artifact digest (32 bytes of 0x66) in both versions; the actual file SHA-256 is recorded separately.

changes: Sort compact row numbers with two checked, authorized scratch allocations, then apply a stable permutation to the owned values.
Reuse one transactional chunk scan buffer and discard rejected scan contents before reuse.
Keep the original event table when sorted sequence keys have no collisions.
Deduplicate sorted PCs in place while retaining bounded cancellation checkpoints.
